pages.text: The $(item)Fire Alarm Controller$() is an RC-704 receiver for the fire station. It hears every $(l:radiocraft:alarms/fire_alarm_box)box$(/l) on its frequency and acks each message. Set its frequency and callsign in its menu (E, then 3), or use a commercial license on it.$(br2)Its own screen shows the newest event to anyone near, like a computer monitor.

pages.title: In alarm
pages.text: When a box sends an alarm the controller buzzes once a second, its screen and ALARM lamp turn red, and it powers redstone on every side for the station's bells. A TAMPER or MISSING box buzzes too.$(br2)Right click it for its terminal: the event, its ACCOUNT (box), location and ZONE, DIRECT or VIA relays, and TIME SINCE. Along the bottom: $(thing)NEXT$() steps back through the log, $(thing)SILENCE$(), $(thing)FAST$() back to the newest, $(thing)E$() the menu.

pages.title: Silence
pages.text: SILENCE quiets the buzzer and bells, but the box stays in alarm until its stations are reset with the key. A new alarm within 5 minutes is logged and printed but does not sound again.$(br2)The menu (E) has the event display, the box list (Enter puts a box out of service: no bells, never MISSING), setup, CLEAR HEAD JAM and SILENCE. Sneak and right click steps back through the log in the action bar.

Right click the controller with paper to load its printer, up to 64 sheets. Each event prints a $(item)Fire Alarm Report$() slip in front of it: the zone and kind, day and time, account and location.$(br2)Out of paper it shows PAPER OUT and keeps the slips until you load more. Now and then the head jams: sneak and right click to clear it.

pages.title: FIRE ALARM program
pages.text: On a $(l:radiocraft:computer/radio_computer)radio computer$(/l) touching the controller or on its data wire: every box and its state, and the log, newest first. The header flashes red while an alarm waits. $(thing)F2$() silences, $(thing)F5$() puts the picked box in or out of service, $(thing)Del$() forgets it.$(br2)The $(item)Fire Alarm Floppy Disk$() has no recipe yet: it is in the creative menu.
